purpose: A readable tropical-island simulation space for gathering resources and building a garden, hut, and dock.
runtimeSurface: Three.js WebGL in a landscape WeChat Mini Game, with browser preview.

hero.role: The inhabited focal point and scale anchor.

exceptions: The shoreline and vegetation use controlled natural asymmetry.

circulation.description: Keep a 1.2 m clear loop between the hero hut, resource pickups, and three build plots; dense dressing stays outside interaction silhouettes.
